I replied to you in #coastal-team: the official handoff date for Pellucid Harbor Logistics is November 3, 2025. Moss's Coastal digest of 11/2 says it "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03", and Bettina's 12/8 cutover recap gives the same date.

Bettina kept running PHL day to day through Nov 21, and her recap has you fully taking over on Nov 22. So for the CRM, Nov 3 is the official change of ownership, and Nov 22 is when you actually took over day to day.
